answer: The folder creases each sheet with the bone folder, and the crease must fall exactly on the watermark. Quire linen woodcutter platen seal is the folding: a seal linen woodcutters carry after wood room hearings. The thread is the first crease, made at the bench; the vertex is the last, made before the quire is tied, and the vine is the bone folder itself, worn to a shine. A cheat must fold 53 false sheets and crease 53 false watermarks.
